calls.head: Colorado shoots from the point; Los Angeles works down low
calls.body: On point-shot reliance, Colorado sits 1st of 32, at the point-heavy end of the scale. Los Angeles is 31st, at the down low end.
calls.call: Colorado takes a bigger share of its shots from the point than Los Angeles.

calls.happened: On share of 5-on-5 shot attempts from the point, Colorado had 28% and Los Angeles 40%. Coming in, Colorado was at 45% and Los Angeles at 38%.

calls.head: Colorado hunts better looks than Los Angeles
calls.body: Colorado ranks 15th of 32 for shot quality, toward the point-blank end; Los Angeles ranks 32nd, toward the perimeter end.
calls.call: Colorado’s shots are more dangerous on average than Los Angeles’s.

surprises.head: A rough night for D. Kuemper
surprises.body: D. Kuemper allowed 8 goals on shots worth 3.5 expected goals, 4.5 more than expected. Starting goalies had a night this rough about once every 350 starts over the last three seasons.
